missing: Three refutations. (1) The stop is not enforced at admission: register_task never consults it — a task registered after apply_stop runs uncancelled (vc_201_080_mastery_post_stop_registration_runs). (2) Scope is a label, not enforcement: tasks carry no scope so a region-a stop cancels region-b work (vc_201_080_mastery_scope_does_not_scope). (3) The persisted stop is unsigned JSON — flipping active:false lifts it silently across restart (vc_201_080_mastery_tampered_file_lifts_the_stop). EmergencyStopBus has no production caller. Holds: pre-registered cancellable tasks cancel, unreachable peers and unrecallable externals report, untampered persistence survives (vc_201_080_mastery_nominal_stop_holds).
